responsibility: Defines the IA-64 RTL operand predicates used by machine-description patterns to recognize legal registers, immediates, addresses, symbols, predicates, and special architectural registers. Beyond generic register tests, it encodes IA-64-specific legality rules for small-data and GOT references, TLS and offset forms, FP constant handling, comparison operators, base registers, and special AR registers, making it the semantic operand filter paired with constraints.md.
